# SARIF 2.1.0 schema (test data only)

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is the official JSON schema of the OASIS Static
Analysis Results Interchange Format (SARIF) Version 2.1.0, Errata 01, copied
unchanged from

<https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json>

(SHA-256 `c3b4bb2d6093897483348925aaa73af03b3e3f4bd4ca38cef26dcb4212a2682e`,
fetched 2026-10-10). The tests of `pathwarden-export` validate Pathwarden's
SARIF output against it. It is not compiled into or shipped with any binary.
